quotes.quote: Characteristic features are delayed separation of the umbilical cord and strong leukocytosis, especially neutrophilia, during periods of infection.
Leukocyte adhesion deficiency (LAD) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by decreased expression or functioning of CD18, the β_2 subunit of the leukocyte β_2 integrins [1].

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Batch HGVS: c.1628_1657+6del, a 36-nt genomic deletion spanning the end of exon 12 and the start of intron 12; predicted p.?. The paper describes a 36-nt deletion seen in cDNA (c.1622_1657del36) with an in-frame protein change p.Cys541_Gly553del insTrp, and labels the mechanism "Deletion? Splice site?". The paper describes the disease as caused by decreased expression or function of CD18 (the β2 integrin subunit).

quotes.quote: Leukocyte adhesion deficiency (LAD) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by decreased expression or functioning of CD18, the β_2 subunit of the leukocyte β_2 integrins [1].
Usually, this leads to the absence or decreased expression of the β_2 integrins on the leukocyte surface, but sometimes a normal expression of nonfunctional β_2 integrins is found.

concerns: PMID 22134107 is a mutation-update table (Table I) without case descriptions: people are identified only by database accession numbers, and sex, age and clinical features are not given per person.

In Table I the LAD-I type and the families (alleles) count belong to the table row (the variant), not to one accession number; for an accession number listed with a second variant, the expression class reflects the person's genotype, not this allele alone.

Numbering and description differ: the paper gives "c.1622_1657del36 (cDNA)" with mutation type "Deletion? Splice site?", i.e. a deletion observed in cDNA whose genomic cause was not settled; the batch's genomic HGVS c.1628_1657+6del is a normalized form that moves the deletion into intron 12. The panel should confirm which DNA change, if any, was shown.
Protein differs from the batch prediction: paper p.Cys541_Gly553del insTrp (in frame), batch p.?.

A second ITGB2 variant (c.2200G>T, p.Glu734X) is listed under the same accession number A0040; the cited source [52] is titled as describing a stalk-region deletion and a cytoplasmic truncation in one patient.
notes_for_panel: The cited primary report [52] (Hixson et al. 2004) was not available to this dossier.
